items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Peter Boccage, Henry Boccage. He's playing tuba.

ctx.x: Oh, they made a big hit by there. They played in New York. And they made a big hit up there. They had records out. You don't have any records? Yeah, they came back here. They had all the pictures years back in Maison Blanche. They had the lyrics during that time. We told it. They had the lyrics during that time. And they played that for a week. That's a lyric, you know, on the stage. For people to see them. Yeah, they had Peter. And he had three brothers there playing. Peter Boccage, Henry Boccage. He's playing…
Were there any other drummers that were outstanding that you can remember when you were a boy that you liked especially?
